overall_summary: All historical videos have extremely low views (4-20 views) and zero engagement, making it statistically impossible to declare a definitive winning pattern. Performance is flat across topics. Therefore, confidence is low, and the strategy requires a controlled exploration recommendation focusing on tighter, highly visual first-person hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos mentioning phone numbers and chat logs (A_eLARoegnw with 20 views, a9-G1X5jEOU with 15 views) slightly outperformed abstract concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on tactile, everyday digital interactions like typing and erasing messages.

weak_patterns.evidence: Openings like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc) and 'आधी रात को' (WvZxup1LQYo) yielded low views (9-12) and zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting with generic timestamps; start directly with an action or a specific object.

next_video.concept: Typing a long message to an ex, reading it twice, and deleting it before pressing send.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound or visual of typing a message that will never be sent.
next_video.twist_direction: Instead of sending it, you close the app and realize the person has already forgotten how you type.
next_video.reason: Tests if high-anxiety everyday texting habits drive better retention than passive late-night reflections.

experiment: Testing active micro-behaviors (typing and deleting a message) over passive observation hooks.
